# VADO: VISION Arch. & Engineering Consultants

> VADO (VISION Arch. & Engineering Consultants) is a multidisciplinary architecture and engineering consultancy based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. Established in 1994, VADO delivers architectural design, engineering, project management, and site supervision for urban, landscape, cultural, retail, hospitality, and residential projects across Saudi Arabia.

## About

- Legal name: VISION Arch. & Engineering Consultants
- Founded: 1994
- Headquarters: Al Fardan Tower, Office 401, Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
- Area served: Saudi Arabia
- Disciplines: architecture, engineering, project development
- Website: https://vado.sa

## Services

- Architectural Design: Creative architectural solutions that balance aesthetics, function, and context, turning vision into architecture.
- Engineering Design: Integrated structural and MEP engineering ensuring safety, efficiency, and sustainability in every project.
- Project Management: Comprehensive project management from concept to completion, aligning quality, schedule, and budget.
- Site Supervision: Dedicated on-site supervision delivering precision, consistency, and construction excellence.

## Projects

- [Al Hamra Waterfront](https://vado.sa/projects/al-hamra-waterfront): Waterfront masterplan for Dammam Municipality transforming Al Hamra Corniche into a public destination with a marina, parks, cultural landmarks, and pedestrian promenades on the Arabian Gulf.
- [Courtyard Villa](https://vado.sa/projects/courtyard-villa): Contemporary private residential villa in Al Khobar combining modern geometric masses with arched openings, natural limestone, and daylight-filled living spaces.
- [Tholal](https://vado.sa/projects/tholal): Open-air commercial boulevard in Al Khobar for MSM Group, bringing retail, dining, and leisure together with shaded walkways, terraces, and public plazas.
- [Matal](https://vado.sa/projects/matal): Waterfront mixed-use dining and leisure destination in Al Khobar with premium restaurants, panoramic terraces, and landscaped plazas overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

## Guiding Principles

- Innovation: Turning vision into architecture through creative, forward-thinking design that answers to context and purpose.
- Sustainability: Designing responsibly to shape functional environments built to serve communities and endure for generations.
- Precision: Holding to engineering rigor and disciplined execution, from first concept to the final detail on site.
